description: Refactor recommendation system architecture: create RecommendationOrchestrator, ComponentManager, ScoringRegistry, and FallbackStrategy for loose coupling and extensibility
steps: Design and implement RecommendationOrchestrator in backend/app/agents/recommendation_orchestrator.py that coordinates components without tight coupling.
Create ComponentManager in backend/app/agents/component_manager.py for dynamic loading and management of recommendation components.
Implement ScoringRegistry in backend/app/agents/scoring_registry.py for pluggable scoring strategies with priority and weight configuration.
Create FallbackStrategy system in backend/app/agents/fallback_strategy.py with configurable fallback chains and degradation policies.
Refactor agent interfaces in backend/app/agents/base.py and create backend/app/agents/interfaces.py with clear contracts and versioning.
Create adapter classes to make existing RecommendationAgentV2 and other components work with new architecture.
Update orchestrator.py to use new RecommendationOrchestrator (optional, can run alongside existing).
Test new architecture: verify components can be added/removed dynamically, system more resilient to failures.
acceptance_criteria: RecommendationOrchestrator can coordinate different scoring strategies and components
Components can be registered, discovered, and loaded dynamically via ComponentManager
Multiple scoring strategies can be combined with configurable weights via ScoringRegistry
System gracefully degrades when components fail using FallbackStrategy
All agents implement standardized interface from interfaces.py
Existing functionality preserved through adapter pattern
New architecture produces same results as old system (verified by tests)
verification: cd backend && python -c "from app.agents.recommendation_orchestrator import RecommendationOrchestrator; from app.agents.component_manager import ComponentManager; cm=ComponentManager(); ro=RecommendationOrchestrator(cm); print('Architecture OK')"
cd backend && python -c "from app.agents.scoring_registry import ScoringRegistry; sr=ScoringRegistry(); sr.register('test_scorer', lambda x: {'score': 0.5}); print('ScoringRegistry OK')"
cd backend && python -c "from app.agents.fallback_strategy import FallbackStrategy; fs=FallbackStrategy(); fs.add_fallback('primary', 'fallback'); print('FallbackStrategy OK')"
cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_recommendation_orchestrator.py -v (create orchestrator tests)
